name: Savage Worlds Adventure Edition
description: The core ruleset for Savage Worlds, providing fast, fun, and furious rules for narrative and miniature-based games across various genres.

name: Fantasy Companion
description: A 272-page book with setting rules, races, items, monsters, and spells for medieval fantasy settings, compatible with Savage Worlds Adventure Edition.

name: Science Fiction Companion
description: A 300+ page book with character ancestries, gear, arcane backgrounds, setting rules, and a bestiary for sci-fi adventures, updated for Savage Worlds Adventure Edition.

name: Horror Companion
description: A 202-page book with rules for monsters, signs, portents, and settings for horror genres, from classic monster movies to cosmic horror, compatible with Savage Worlds Adventure Edition.

name: Super Powers Companion
description: A companion book with rules for creating superheroes, villains, powers, and settings for superhero campaigns, compatible with Savage Worlds Adventure Edition.
